title: ELUM — Visual routine app with action cards for autism, ADHD and developmental disabilities
description: ELUM turns the daily routine a guardian writes into easy, step-by-step picture cards. A visual schedule made with people with developmental disabilities, autism, ADHD and learning disabilities — and their guardians — in mind.
ogTitle: ELUM — Daily routines, one action card at a time
ogDescription: Guardians make the routine, Elumi follows along card by card. Free on iOS and Android.
schemaDescription: A daily-life helper with action cards. Shows the day's routine as picture cards in order — a visual schedule.

hero.lede: Write one line the way you'd say it, and ELUM turns it into easy picture cards in order. Cards only appear on Elumi's phone after the guardian checks them.
hero.hintHtml: Stuck? See the FAQ or contact us.

steps.title: The guardian writes
steps.body: Describe the situation the way you'd say it, like “Get ready for school on a rainy day”.

steps.title: It becomes cards
steps.body: It's split into small steps with a picture and a short sentence. The guardian edits and checks them.

steps.title: Elumi follows along
steps.body: One card at a time, with a check for each. Stars and the promised reward wait at the end.

featuresSub: Getting ready for school, morning routines, washing and brushing teeth, going out, bedtime — the things you do every day, as a visual schedule.
faqSub: Can't find your answer? Email us below.

faq.a: We made it with people who understand pictures and order more easily than text in mind — people with developmental disabilities or on the autism spectrum, people with ADHD or learning disabilities who like to see their steps at a glance — and the guardians and teachers who look after the day with them. We don't divide users by age.

faq.q: Does it work on both iPhone and Android?
faq.a: Yes. Get it on the App Store or Google Play. The guardian's phone and Elumi's phone can be different kinds and still link.

faq.q: Where do I get the link code?
faq.a: Make a link code on the guardian screen, then enter it on Elumi's phone to connect the two. Forgot it? Make a new one on the guardian screen — the old code stops working from then on.

faq.q: How do I go back to the guardian screen?
faq.a: Switching from Elumi's screen needs the passcode you set at the start, so settings can't be changed by accident.
Check your internet connection first. If it still fails, email us the error code shown on screen (for example E-1001) so we can find where it stopped.

faq.q: The cards read a little odd
faq.a: Cards are made by AI and only reach Elumi after the guardian checks them. Edit the wording or make them again on the guardian screen.

faq.q: Where does what I write go?
faq.a: The situation and answers you write are sent as written to an AI provider to make the cards, so please don't include names, phone numbers, addresses or anything that identifies a person. The text is also kept on the ELUM server so you can review and edit it, and it's deleted when you delete your account. Details are in the privacy policy (Korean).

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Tap Delete account in the guardian screen's settings. Routines, Elumi's information and stars are deleted right away and can't be restored. To stop free usage limits from being claimed again, minimal data such as the login identifier and AI usage count is kept for one year and then deleted. To have it deleted sooner, email chan4760@gmail.com. See the account deletion guide (Korean).
Install the app on the new phone, make a new link code on the guardian screen and enter it.
